description: Generates a deployment-ready Markdown runtime-enforcement plan for an agentic AI deployment. Maps target framework(s) + agent capabilities + (optional) IMDA risk taxonomy to 8 runtime control families: policy-as-code, tool gating, memory scoping, delegation controls, audit envelopes, decision envelope, continuous evaluation, incident response. When MGF-AGENTIC is in scope, prescribes the MCP server whitelist (§2.3.1 of the IMDA framework).

riskTaxonomy.description: IMDA MGF-Agentic v1.0 §1.2.2 — 5 risk types. Used to expand recommended controls beyond capability mapping.

name: generate_runtime_enforcement_plan
